title: Man in 'serious but stable condition' after shooting in Austin involving ICE officer: Officials
text:
A man is in “serious but stable condition” after being shot in Austin, Texas, on Sunday afternoon in an incident that involved an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer, according to local officials.

“At approximately 12:56 in the afternoon today, the Austin-Travis County EMS received a notification from the Austin Police Department of a reported shooting at the 8000 block of Anderson Square,” Chief of the Austin-Travis County Emergency Medical Services Robert Luckritz said at an initial press conference with other city officials. “EMS responded immediately and was on scene within three and a half minutes. One individual was identified as suffering from a gunshot wound. The patient was stable, vital signs were stable, but in serious condition. They were transported off the scene within 9 minutes of arrival of EMS resources and transported to a local trauma center.” He later noted the man was shot in the torso.
